Despite the task being a straightforward factual query with a well-known answer (orange), the Planner failed to recognize the high confidence level of the expected answer. It repeatedly instructed the WebSurfer to search for "official" or "government" sources (like koningsdag.nl and rijksoverheid.nl) that yielded no results, incorrectly assuming a formal government dress code was necessary to validate the answer. This led to unnecessary repetition of the same queries and a failure to conclude the task efficiently, matching the pattern of "Repetitive Searches" and "Failure to Synthesize" seen in the reference examples.
